payload.text: hv, 3 Nov, first-hand in vc's session, received by vc's date -u of 11:29Z, on vc's two recommendations at boot: "Go with your recommendations." and "Sure, but not today. Bank this and get ready for a close. We're not doing anything here on this repo today." So (1) 2.14.9's path (decision 87) does not resume today: it waits for devbin-vc, which holds all devbin work today, since R2's and R3's outputs and the CI verdict on hv's push go to it; (2) kovacs-sysadm's Linux-leg finding (arngz's lua test dependency is declared only in CI's apt line, so utilz doctor is silent on a host without lua; banked in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-vc/inbound-20261103-kovacs-sysadm-arngz-lua-dep.md) is filed by vc as a low issue once Utilz resumes, deferred past 2.14.9 by name (watch-out 22), and fixed after the cut. Nothing is done on Utilz on 3 Nov, and vc closes for the day. Peers read this decision at pickup; cc and dc record no copy.
